findings.title: Flooded out of their tents, Gaza families have nowhere left to go
findings.affected_population_system: Displaced residents in 270 shelter sites/camps identified as at flood risk; Gaza City stormwater drainage system and municipal emergency crews.
findings.summary: Gaza Municipality spokesperson Hosni Muhanna reported that damage had reduced the city's drainage capacity to 20%; 270 camps and shelter sites were at risk of flooding. Municipal crews received 250 storm-related calls for flooded streets, erosion and blocked drains and said they responded to most. These quantified municipal capacity and service-response details are new to the supplementary watch, not a newly dated storm or casualty incident.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Muhanna warned that 270 camps and shelter sites in Gaza City were at risk of flooding.
findings.source_type: Established news agency reporting attributed to named Gaza Municipality spokesperson; municipal operational statement
